newsitem.title: USA: GreenPoint to buy back $200 mln of stock.
newsitem.headline: GreenPoint to buy back $200 mln of stock.

text.p: GreenPoint Financial Corp said Monday that it's board of directors authorized the repurchase of up to $200 million of company common stock, over an unspecified period of time.

The company said that the stock repurchases are in addition to an authorization in February, to buy back up to five percent of its shares. The repurchase under that authorization is about 75 percent complete.

Separately, GreenPoint also announced the sale of $200 million of 9.10 percent Capital Securities, due June 1, 2027, issued by GreenPoint Capital Trust I, a newly created subsidiary business trust of GreenPoint Financial Corp.

Proceeds from the offering, said the company, will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include the repurchase of stock and financing growth. The capital securities were sold in a private placement to qualified institutional buyers.

GreenPoint specializes in no-documentation residential mortgages through its principal subsidiaries GreenPoint Mortgage, in Charlotte, NC, and GreenPoint Bank, a New York State chartered savings bank.
